# **Use Case and Dataset Status**

Where the working group's use cases and dataset requests stand. Use cases come from issues labeled `Use Case` in [OHDSI/GIS](https://github.com/OHDSI/GIS/issues?q=label%3A%22Use+Case%22); dataset requests come from [OHDSI/gaiaCatalog](https://github.com/OHDSI/gaiaCatalog/issues?q=label%3A%22data+source+request%22) (plus a few older ones in OHDSI/GIS). Status, dates and dependencies are read from GitHub each time the site is built. Status and rank come from the [GIS project board](https://github.com/orgs/OHDSI/projects/26), which the working group updates at the weekly meeting. External owners and links GitHub does not record are kept in [`status-config.json`](https://github.com/OHDSI/GIS/blob/main/rmd/data/status-config.json).

## **How use cases shape the toolchain**

Development is use-case driven. Each use case feeds one or more parts of the toolchain.

| Area | What use cases identify |
|---|---|
| **Vocabulary** | Missing concepts, mapping gaps, hierarchy needs and synonyms for geospatial and environmental variables |
| **CDM extensions** | Auxiliary table designs, fields for `external_exposure` and related tables, indexing and performance needs, linkage patterns between clinical data and geospatial sources |
| **Analysis** | HADES enhancements, custom libraries for geospatial processing, federated analysis protocols, exposure quality validation (see [Analysis](analysis.html)) |

To propose one, see [Get Started](get-started.html#propose-a-use-case). Proposals are reviewed against:

| Criterion | Question |
|---|---|
| Scientific rigor | Is there a clear hypothesis and study design? |
| Generalizability | Does it apply beyond a single institution or dataset? |
| Technical feasibility | Are the required geospatial data sources available? |
| Community benefit | Does it contribute to shared toolchain components? |
| OHDSI principles | Does it support open science, reproducibility and collaboration? |

<br>

## **How to read this page**

- **Status.** The Status of the item on the project board: *Idea*, *Proposed*, *To do*, *In progress*, *Blocked* or *Complete*. Exceptions: *On hold* (issue labeled `On Hold`), *Superseded* (replaced by another use case) and *Complete* (issue closed) take precedence.
- **Dependencies.** Issues listed under "Depends On" or in a task list on the use case (or dataset request) issue, with open or closed state. Progress is the number of those that are closed. A dataset request lists the use cases that depend on it under "Needed by".
- **Requested.** The date the issue was opened.
- **External owner.** The person or organization outside the working group that asked for it.
- **WG owner.** The working group member assigned to the issue.
- **Rank.** Priority order set by the working group (1 is highest). The column appears once ranks are set on the board.
